description:
Signs an existing Apple player in using the identity token obtained by the app's Apple consent flow.
Use when: the player requests Apple signin with a token whose audience matches this project's Apple configuration.
Not for: driving provider UI, dashboard-account signin, or automatically signing up after any error. Only USER_NOT_FOUND permits the explicit horizon_signup_apple flow.
Side effects: validates the identity token and creates a player session; it does not create an account or retry.
Returns: user details, appleUserId, isPrivateRelayEmail, authStatus: AUTHENTICATED and accessToken. includeRefreshToken=true adds refreshToken and both expiry timestamps.
Errors: 404 USER_NOT_FOUND permits signup with the still-valid identity JWT and first-consent name fields. 400 INVALID_APPLE_TOKEN or APPLE_NOT_CONFIGURED requires correction, not signup. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

appleIdentityToken.description: Apple identity-token JWT obtained after player consent, with audience matching this project's configured Services ID or Bundle ID

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

name: horizon_signin_apple
title: Sign In with Apple
